title: Restaurants Billing
cardDescription: Restaurant POS covering orders, tables, kitchen display, GST invoices, UPI/card payments, inventory and reports in one integrated platform.
overview: Restaurants Billing is a restaurant operations platform covering POS, table and floor management, kitchen display, billing, inventory and reporting. Orders flow from a waiter's tablet or a QR menu straight to the kitchen.
problem: Restaurants juggle orders, tables, kitchen tickets, billing and stock across separate tools or paper, which causes delays, wrong orders and lost revenue data.
solution: A single POS where orders move from waiter tablet or QR menu to the kitchen display, tables and reservations are tracked live, and bills are generated with taxes, discounts and multiple payment modes.
result: Restaurant staff handle ordering, kitchen flow, billing and reporting from one system, with sales and inventory records available to owners at any time.
features: POS billing with GST / tax invoices
Order flow from waiter tablet or QR menu to kitchen display
Menu with variants, add-ons, sold-out status and time-based menus
Cash, card and UPI payments, discounts
Customer loyalty, inventory, expenses and staff modules
contributions: Built responsive React interfaces for POS and billing
Implemented order and table management workflows
Integrated frontend with backend REST APIs
Improved usability for fast, touch-friendly billing

challenges.challenge: Billing screens must be fast during rush hours.
challenges.solution: Designed a touch-first POS layout with minimal clicks per order and quick menu search.

challenges.challenge: Menus change by time of day and stock.
challenges.solution: Added variants, add-ons, sold-out flags and time-based menu rules managed from the admin side.
